aiona santana.bio: Venezuelan-Canadian singer-songwriter and producer Aiona Santana blends Latin pop, R&B and contemporary urban music with Venezuelan rhythms and multilingual songwriting.

ash koley.bio: Winnipeg duo Ash Koley pairs vocalist Ashley Koley with guitarist and keyboardist Phil Deschambault in bright Canadian new wave and alternative pop.

audio playground.bio: Edmonton-formed Canadian dance-pop group Audio Playground combines electronic club production with pop and R&B vocals and has released multilingual dance singles for Canadian and international audiences.

blake mcgrath.bio: Mississauga-born Canadian dancer, choreographer and singer Blake McGrath built an international dance career before expanding into pop and R&B as a recording artist.

bénita.bio: Toronto-born R&B singer-songwriter Bénita is a Canadian vocalist and Juno-nominated songwriter whose work combines contemporary soul, intimate songwriting and polished pop production.

chad kroeger.bio: Hanna, Alberta-born singer, guitarist and songwriter Chad Kroeger is a Canadian rock musician best known as the frontman and primary songwriter of Nickelback.

chloë doucet.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Chloë Doucet makes jangly, guitar-driven indie pop that draws on classic pop-rock textures while keeping a contemporary Canadian songwriting sensibility.

chris larocca.bio: Woodbridge, Ontario singer-songwriter Chris LaRocca is a Canadian R&B artist and songwriter whose credits include collaborations with Bryson Tiller, Summer Walker, Kali Uchis and other contemporary artists.

clothesline from hell.bio: Toronto songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Adam LaFramboise records as Clothesline From Hell, blending acoustic songwriting with hip-hop loops, programmed drums and scrappy alternative-pop production.

cootie catcher.bio: Toronto indie-pop group cootie catcher mixes twee, jangle pop, new wave and lo-fi electronics with playful arrangements and emotionally direct songwriting.

craig smart.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter Craig Smart is a pop and dance vocalist known for solo radio releases and collaborations with electronic producers including Marc Mysterio and Trevor Guthrie.
